//ApiBaseUrl: Primary API (MonsterASP). The scheme is cleartext http: because no certificate is bound to the runasp.net host (DEPLOYMENT.md 5 and 7).
//BackupApiBaseUrl: Secondary API (Azure). The URL is https and the app starts there, but as measured 1 Nov 2026 it has no database it can reach - /api/health reports Degraded and every data route fails - so it is not yet a working fallback. See DEPLOYMENT.md 7.2: the Monster ASP SQL name resolves to a private address, so this copy needs its own database. ApiFallbackHandler retries here on any 500 from the primary, which currently doubles the latency of a failing request rather than recovering it.
